name: projective
//: This project is Deno-native. There was no package.json before, so `npm run dev` did not exist —
the only entry point was `deno task dev`. This file adds the npm aliases and nothing else: every
script delegates straight to the matching Deno task, so the two entry points cannot drift and
`deno.json` stays the single place a command is actually defined.
It declares NO dependencies on purpose. Deno 2 auto-detects a package.json and will install what
it lists; an empty one leaves module resolution exactly as it was (verified with `deno task check`
and the full 469-test suite both before and after adding it). Do not add dependencies here —
they belong in the `imports` map in deno.json.
npm run dev:mock  -> fixtures  (USE_MOCKS=true, overrides every per-domain gate)
